topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can hardly believe what happened this morning. My car, the one that’s always been so dependable, was just gone from my driveway. The spot where it usually sits felt emptier than I expected. I found a ticket on my doorstep, a notice that it had been towed. The reasons aren’t clear to me, and I can’t help but think about all the things that need to be done now—figuring out where it’s been taken, how to get it back, and the costs involved. The whole day feels off, and I keep looking outside, hoping to see it return on its own. But that’s not how things work, is it?
